sourceDefect.reason: Current JS and scoped original page agree, but the stated condition g(f(x))<0 restricts integer x to exactly five values while the prompt requires six solutions of the system for some natural c; no c can satisfy it.

findings.detail: Original PDF page 4 and current JS both state f(x)=log_{sqrt(3)}(x/3), g(x)=x^2−2x. g(f(x))<0 implies 0<f(x)<2, hence 3<x<9 and the only integer x are 4,5,6,7,8. Six integer solutions are impossible for every c.
